messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] July 2026 PR of the Month
messages.body:
I'd like to vote for #61550 and #69295.

#61550 -- Itay (@itayweb) patiently followed up on the PR and resolved all
the comments **over the last five months**.
#69295 -- Guan-Ming (@guan404ming) helped with `airflow-ts-pack`, which
will serve as the user entrypoint for the upcoming TypeScript SDK. I'd also
like to give a shoutout to Shivam (@shivaam), who started the TS SDK back
when we were still preparing for the 3.3 release, and who also helped
review this PR.

Best regards,
Jason
